title: core: risk remediation R-14 (stale cache) + R-27 (silent language drop)
description:
[from board/docs/risks-v2.md · exec plan: docs/v2-execution-plan.md · batch B2/B3]
Seats: CORE-03/CORE-05 (lead TL-CORE).
Two MATERIALIZED defects found and proved by RISK-2.
R-14 — stale analysis: store::cache_valid compared only max(mtime) at whole-second granularity, so a same-second edit, a git checkout/touch -r that preserves mtime, or an edit of a non-newest file was a cache HIT and stale analysis/index was served silently.
R-27 — silent language drop: pipeline::build_index dispatched only rust/python and the `_` arm returned empty vectors with no warning, so TS/JS (INTEL-4's analyzer exists and is golden-tested) indexed as files with 0 symbols while the UI claimed the language was supported.

EVIDENCE (CORE-03, lead TL-CORE, 2026-10-16T00:27:25Z):
Files: crates/core/src/store.rs, crates/core/src/walk.rs, crates/core/src/pipeline.rs (+ tests in those files), and crates/core/src/learn.rs (R-14 residual: CORE-10/learn.rs had landed, so the concurrent-edit hazard had cleared and the verifier pinned the learn-level residual to this card — see below).

R-14 — per-file cache stamps (nanosecond mtime + byte size).
New sidecar `.repowalk/cache-header.json` (CacheHeader { version: 1, files: [{ path, mtime_nanos, size }] }), written atomically by store::save beside the frozen index.json (Index schema untouched). store::cache_valid no longer compares a global max(mtime) at whole-second granularity: it loads the header, requires equal cardinality, and compares every file's current (nanosecond mtime, size) as a set — any mismatch, addition, removal or vanished file is a miss. walk.rs gains pub(crate) mtime_nanos()/file_size(); the old mtime_secs() stays for FileEntry.mtime callers and the cache never uses it.
R-14 residual (learn.rs analysis-stamps.json, the cache the CLI/GUI actually serve): VER-3's battery pinned this to CORE-8. Stamp changed from `(mtime_seconds, line_count)` to `(mtime_nanos, size)` and STAMP_VERSION bumped 1 -> 2, reusing the same walk helpers; both ignored residual tests now pass under `--ignored`.
Three regression tests (all fail loudly on the old behaviour): store::tests::same_second_edit_invalidates (two writes, same byte length, whole-second mtime identical, +1ns), store::tests::size_change_with_preserved_mtime_invalidates (touch -r style, mtime byte-for-byte identical, size differs), store::tests::edit_of_non_newest_file_invalidates (edit the older of two files; global max mtime unchanged). Plus added_or_removed_file_invalidates. Results: cargo test -p repowalk-core --lib store:: -> 10 passed; 0 failed.
Verify hook: grep -n as_secs crates/core/src/store.rs -> no match (exit 1): zero cache-validity use of seconds. walk.rs still has mtime_secs/as_secs for FileEntry.mtime, unused by the cache.

R-27 — explicit language dispatch. pipeline now routes every file through analyze::Lang::from_walk: rust/python keep parse_rust/parse_py; TypeScript/JavaScript have no v1 parser so their symbols/call-sites are lifted from the v2 analyzer (analyze::analyze with an empty symbol slice) — functions from FunctionCfg, types from TypeNode, CallSites from Call use-sites. Genuinely unsupported languages are reported, never silent: new `pub fn build_index_with_report` -> IndexReport { index, unsupported: Vec<UnsupportedLanguage{language, files}> } + `unsupported_summary()` (e.g. "1 files not analyzed (go)"). build_index/build_index_from_files keep their signatures and progress behaviour (learn.rs untouched by this API).
Before/after (temporary instrumentation, removed): TS-only dir main.ts (greet fn + Greeter class/hello method) -> BEFORE 0 symbols/0 edges (old `_ =>` arm); AFTER 3 symbols [greet, hello, Greeter] / 1 edge. Unsupported `.go` dir -> [UnsupportedLanguage { language: "go", files: 1 }], summary Some("1 files not analyzed (go)").
Verify hook: a TS-only temp dir reports non-zero symbols through build_index (old behaviour printed 0) and an unsupported-language dir reports explicitly.

GATES (2026-10-16T00:27Z):
  cargo fmt -p repowalk-core -- --check -> my four files clean (rustfmt --check store.rs walk.rs pipeline.rs learn.rs -> ok). The crate-wide check is RED only on crates/core/tests/v2_acceptance.rs (VER-3/VER-08's brand-new, still-in-flight acceptance file, not mine to edit); every one of its index-cache and R-27 assertions passes.
  cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0 (finished, 0 warnings).
  cargo test -p repowalk-core -> exit 0: lib 162 passed/0 failed/2 ignored; analysis_golden 10, contract 6, export_emitters 10, golden 1, grammar_abi 4, v2_acceptance 12 passed/0 failed/3 ignored, walk_metrics 2, doctest 1. 0 failed everywhere.
  Run with --ignored: the two R-14 residual tests (r14_same_second_rewrite_is_a_miss, r14_size_change_with_preserved_mtime_is_a_miss) now pass; the only remaining ignored failure is anti_unloadable_artifact_must_force_full_reanalysis (OPEN CORE-11, a different finding).
No new dependencies. Nothing committed or pushed.
